steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Music videos serve multiple purposes: promoting the song and artist, extending the artist's star image, creating visual narratives, and generating additional revenue and audience engagement. | Key Fact: Performance videos feature the artist performing (singing, dancing, playing instruments), creating a sense of authenticity and connecting the audience with the artist's live persona. | Key Fact: Narrative videos tell a story — either illustrating the song's lyrics (amplification) or creating a separate narrative. Some combine performance and narrative elements. | Key Fact: Conventions of music video: quick cuts and editing to the beat, close-ups of the artist, stylised lighting and colour, choreography, and visual motifs linked to the song.
